evidence_slice: East Herts District Council's Bishop's Stortford North (Stortford Fields) page states that a minimum of 2,529 new homes shall be accommodated within the allocated sites at Bishop's Stortford North, including 2,200 homes within Stortford Fields and 329 within St Michael's Hurst; the Council has now approved 479 homes at St Michael's Hurst, taking the overall total to 2,679, with build-out expected to continue until 2033; the initial outline planning permission for Stortford Fields is 3/13/0804/OP.
